notes.title: Update Notes Jun 12
notes.content:
Spent a lot of time just working on general improvements/polish all over the game, most importantly, I'm really happy with the key bindings now, hopefully you agree 😅

[b]Input Management/Handling:[/b]
- Completely rework a lot of the keybind handling for actions which use a modifier key, allowing it to be fully rebound.
- Finish implementing all of the keybinds setting page, so it's now fully functional
- Implement ability to reset all keybindings to defaults
- Building Selection, now has the "shift drag/click" logic like many rts/td games have. Although the "shift" is completely rebindable.

[b]Buildings:[/b]
- Allow towers to shoot through each other, allowing them to be placed right up against the path, without hitting quick limits.
- Randomize the model we use for Geodes when spawned, previously we used the same one everywhere.
- Miners now have a 1-4 prestige unlock, currently this just increases the output of resource harvested, but will do more in the future
    this is mainly just so we can test the concept... we need to improve waves 75-150, it turns into a lot of waiting. Hopefully this change will help in later game a little more, and allow for more usage of other miners, since you can just prestige a single one
- Fix bug with miner UI when corrupting and you have no resources for it, it would show incorrect state.

[b]Other:[/b]
- Add setting to enable auto selection of a random upgrade card after a boss wave
- Add a second setting to make the above auto pick the highest rarity rather than random.
- Implemented a few minor performance improvements here and there.
- Realized that we had one of our enemies randomly disabled and re-enabled it...
- Improved stat tracking for values used on leaderboard & end game screen and ensure they're correctly being updated when we make certain actions.

notes.title: Update Notes Jun 10
notes.content:
Mainly shipped a few QOL/Bug fixes for this one

[b]Modifiers[/b]
[list]
[*]Ensure unlocked modifiers are reset between runs
[*]Ability to remove a modifier from a tower
[*]Refund modifiers when selling a tower
[*]Info on the modifiers applied tab explaining what they do and such
[*]Add info about modifiers to tutorial screen
[/list]

[b]Building Sell System[/b]
This one has been difficult from the start, since the game is getting so complex now 😅
[list]
[*]Correctly handle buildings which have additional buildings attached(like miners) so prices are correctly calculated/refunded.
[*]Track resource spending on buildings more efficiently
[/list]

[b]Building Logs Tab[/b]
[list]
[*]Added some support for future handling of different log types
[*]Handle pushing updates more efficiently, fast firing towers will now group/accumulate updates so we're pushing less UI updates, will help with framerates when it's open
[/list]

[b]Others[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issues with movement when in game speed > 1x, so now we don't move 2x/5x the speed 😅
[*] Fixed issues with internal logging system, so we'll be able to help more with those pesky crashes
[*] Configure UE Crash Reporter to send logs/crash info to our backend, so we can track/fix issues
[/list]
